explanation:
The central tree retains all seven major branches while shrinking from 115 to 76 lines (33.9%) and from 7,755 to 5,262 characters (32.1%). Six peripherals expand meaningful concept nodes using modular boundaries, call paths, state ownership and data dependencies. Positions use measured text dimensions with clear gaps and no overlap; edge line numbers are 1-based.

Source-grounded corrections and qualifications: MappingDocumentController.commitEditorGesture accepts an empty operation list through a direct recorded canvas update; the 1-operation minimum applies to applyOperations (mappingDocumentController.ts:280-286). Opening an already-active CanvasView only stashes its state; switching views prefers a working-copy endpoint over the saved endpoint (canvasHistory.ts:274-288). Move transfer converts EVERY source edge into a jump, including edges between unmoved diagrams, and strictly validates every endpoint (canvasTransfer.ts:134-159). Unrecorded canvas updates leave history unchanged, but select explicitly requests recording (mappingDocumentController.ts:248-253).

Additional detail absent from the seed includes patch propagation into jump spans, collapsed node selections and sections (mappingDocumentController.ts:437-470); collapsed geometry and hit testing (lineGrid.ts:57-95,191-208); endpoint encoding/decoding (canvasHistory.ts:598-631); change-log sequence semantics (canvasHistory.ts:129-135,250-254); and generation identity, count and lifecycle guards (canvasHistory.ts:298-359). History handle isolation is established by canvasHistoryService.ts:49-62; endpoint reconciliation by diagramConnection.ts:47-90.

Evidence is limited to the supplied point, embedded source text and seed. Calls into unprovided helpers are shown only at their visible boundaries. Workspace publication is stated by the transfer source comment; its implementation and runtime behavior were not supplied or tested.
